name: Makha Bucha Day
name_th: วันมาฆบูชา
description: Nationwide 24-hour alcohol ban. All entertainment venues, bars, and clubs closed. Alcohol sales prohibited in all supermarkets and convenience stores.

name: Visakha Bucha Day
name_th: วันวิสาขบูชา
description: Nationwide 24-hour alcohol ban. Commemorates the birth, enlightenment, and passing of the Buddha.

name: Asahna Bucha Day
name_th: วันอาสาฬหบูชา
description: Nationwide 24-hour alcohol ban. First sermon of the Buddha. Bars and clubs closed across Pattaya.

name: Khao Phansa (Buddhist Lent)
name_th: วันเข้าพรรษา
description: Nationwide 24-hour alcohol ban immediately following Asahna Bucha (Double dry day).

name: Awk Phansa (End of Buddhist Lent)
name_th: วันออกพรรษา
description: Nationwide 24-hour alcohol ban. Conclusion of the three-month rains retreat.
